pages.description: Meet the sweetest little forest guide in this adorable Studio Ghibli coloring adventure. This cute baby Catbus is carrying a tiny white Totoro and fluffy little soot sprites inside its magical window. Perfect for kids and anime fans to color in the starry details and cozy characters with their brightest crayons.
